{{Quote|The biggest of the tunnels was labeled AF-two-two-seven-five.|Han Solo|<ref name="Choices" />}}
'''AF-two-two-seven-five''' was an intersection in the [[Cave/Legends|cave]] systems below the [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Poln Minor]]'s surface.<ref name="Choices" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">The events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' take place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]].</ref> [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] members [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] passed the intersection while fleeing from the [[Storm-hair|alien]] [[Ranquiv]]'s forces aboard a [[Speeder bus/Legends|speeder bus]] they [[Thief/Legends|stole]] from the [[Alien/Legends|alien]].<ref name="Choices" />

==Behind the scenes==
AF-two-two-seven-five appeared in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]''.<ref name="Choices" />
